correctness.rationale: For a disjoint matching, perfect coalitions coincide with pairs of non-dominating classes covering every original matching edge. The edge-type graph Q and partner graph H are exact dual two-vertex-cover descriptions. A loop or triangle forces at most three classes; disjoint edge types force at most four. Equality types are precisely 2K2, P4 and C4; surjective type assignments, independent endpoint orientations and division by 4! yield all three exact Stirling coefficients, with n=2 attainable. Independent direct vertex-level enumeration in verify.py reproduces counts and type profiles for n=2..5. No finite test is used as the proof for arbitrary n.

evidence: On a one-regular graph, ordinary domination and perfect domination are equivalent; the separate one-neighbor restriction is automatic. Thus ordinary coalition partitions and perfect coalition partitions coincide.

Existing ordinary and perfect coalition definitions, the scalar four-block maximum and the general possible partner-graph trichotomy are explicitly credited rather than counted as original. Actual searches across equivalent formulations, general coverage, mathematical records and primary articles identified no directly covering count, with residual priority risks from incomplete sources and unindexed literature.

Prior exact enumeration under ordinary-coalition, vertex-cover-coalition or graph color-pattern terminology might be unindexed. Search absence is not uniqueness proof.
The matching realization-count formula may be rediscovered as a straightforward consequence of an unpublished or unlocated type-support enumeration; priority would then require reassessment.

value.rationale: The simplest infinite isolate-free disconnected one-regular family is a canonical test case for coalition partitions. Beyond the previously known upper ceiling and abstract partner-graph options, this gives all optimum partition multiplicities for individually labeled vertices and resolves which optimal partner graphs occur at each n. The three Stirling layers arise from nontrivial support-surjectivity and endpoint-label accounting and provide structural and asymptotic enumeration. It is not merely a small finite calculation, a renamed scalar value or an arbitrary slice.
